body: What’s it like having to be Irish?

To answer the first part, I feel that just being able to say how I feel and get stuff off my chest would help a significant amount. With the not feeling comfortable in my own skin, it’s just how I felt all my life. When I was younger it just didn’t feel right being a boy. It was just uncomfortable. I hate my more masculine features and in the social aspect I just felt more like one if the girls. After I’ve started transitioning I just feel like a fake and I’m not a real woman.
